summary: In the most recent reporting period, Boise State University experienced a range of incidents, including notable occurrences of bike theft and drug-related offenses. Specifically, there were two reported bike thefts at the Micron Engineering Center, indicating a potential pattern of theft in that area. Additionally, incidents involving possession of controlled substances and violations of protection orders were recorded, reflecting ongoing concerns with drug-related activities on campus. Compared to previous months, there has been a slight increase in drug-related offenses, while theft incidents remain consistent. The disposition of many cases reflects a proactive response, with several closed by arrest or citation, indicating effective law enforcement engagement.
